learning: kd 0.2 moved the oval and s-bend, which no geometry change did. Any further gain should be tested before it is trusted on an unseen track.
notes: Final-iteration package: the verified iteration 10 controller (kp 3.0, kd 0.2) on the frozen iteration 9 and 10 geometry. No untested gain was added, so the expected result matches iteration 10's 67.1299 if the pipeline is live.
rationale: The evidence is in the outcome table. Iteration 10 (kd 0.05 to 0.2 at kp 3.0, geometry at the iteration 9 values) is the only verified best, scoring 67.1299. Its gain came from the oval and s-bend, where progress rose to 0.197 and 0.177, and slalom steering_oscillation fell to 0.1626. Every geometry family tested since iteration 1 left max_error at about 0.061 m and one line-loss event per trial, so the controller is the only lever that has moved those tracks. Iterations 9 and 10 used the same geometry, so the Builder's verified platform is the right frame. I considered raising kd further (for example to 0.3) to damp the slalom oscillation. I rejected it because the effect of kd above 0.2 is untested, the unseen track is scored once, and a regression would not be visible before the final race. I therefore keep the iteration 10 controller exactly. The geometry matches the Builder's frozen proposal: sensors at x = -0.04, -0.02, 0, 0.02, 0.04 m with y = 0.07 m, 16 mm footprints, wheel_track 0.10 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, mass 0.8 kg, body 0.12 x 0.18 m. The sensor weights are (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), matching the iteration 8 to 10 scaling. The full measurement set is requested so the final race can be checked against iteration 10 to four decimals.
